item.title: Partners for Life | That's So Wild
item.description: Kelly Wallace, Sr. Wildlife Rehabilitation Specialist at the San Diego Humane Society's Project Wildlife, discussed the monogamous nature of coyotes, who breed once a year and raise their pups together.

item.title: Over 680 properties going up for auction in San Diego County
item.description: People can now register to bid on more than 680 properties available through this year's online property tax auction.

item.title: San Diego leaders approve lowering speed limits after several deadly crashes
item.description: SAN DIEGO (FOX 5/KUSI) — San Diego leaders approved lowering speed limits on designated streets across the city to reduce serious crashes and fatalities. The measure utilizes new authority under a state law known as Assembly Bill 43 (AB 43) to change limits in school zones, business corridors and high-injury streets. item.title: Authorities identify victim in deadly downtown San Diego stabbing
item.description: The San Diego Police Department (SDPD) has identified a man who was stabbed in downtown San Diego outside of Hotel Churchill, a residential facility for low-income, formerly incarcerated or homeless individuals, on Valentine's Day.

item.title: San Diego beach ranked No. 1 in U.S., according to Tripadvisor
item.description: La Jolla Cove in San Diego has been ranked the #1 beach in the US and #7 in the world by Tripadvisor, based on reviews from travelers who enjoyed the beach's calm waters, sea lions, and stunning sunsets.

item.title: Clairemont High could have a new mascot name starting next school year
item.description: Starting next school year, Clairemont High School's "Chieftains" will be changed to "Captains," if approved by the San Diego Unified School District's (SDUSD) Board of Education.

item.title: Full list of concerts at the Rady Shell in 2026
item.description: The Rady Shell, a waterfront open-air venue in San Diego, has hosted major acts since its opening in 2021 and will feature global performers such as Paul Simon, Sarah McLachlan, and "Weird Al" Yankovic in its 2026 lineup.

item.title: Five-day rainfall totals across San Diego County
item.description: San Diego County experienced widespread rain, gusty winds, and some snow due to two winter storms this week, with precipitation totals varying from 0.32 to 5.92 inches depending on the area.

item.title: Mountain lion trapped by San Diego County family
item.description: A Fallbrook family got an unexpected and unsettling surprise this week when a mountain lion turned up in a backyard trap set to catch whatever had been killing their animals.
